metadata.description: Ari Encarnacion's personal Claude Code plugins for open-source and hobby projects

plugins.name: dredd
plugins.description: Re-asserts your CLAUDE.md rules with TypeSafe's Jev decision model — holds commands that likely break a hard rule, cites borderline ones, reviews diffs and PRs on demand, and keeps a per-session ledger in a pane

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window drawn in the band above the prompt — weather icon, percent used, a 12-turn sparkline, and the last turn's change

plugins.name: semantic-diagrams
plugins.description: Ownership-aware architecture, migration, and before/after diagrams in Mermaid — named owner boundaries, fixed status colours and legend, rendered to a local HTML page and published as an Artifact on demand
